pages.title: Focus of Earth
pages.description: This spell focus is attuned to the school of Earth. While equipped, the glyphs of this school will be amplified and discounted. The lesser focus, as a drawback, will weaken glyphs of the other elemental schools. The major focus also grants Mana Regen I while the wearer stand under Y 0.

This focus empowers Poison Spores and Grow, dealing damage to undead with a chance of spawning a spore blossom, and Gravity, when augmented with Sensitive, changing it to create a gravity field that pull entities towards its center (filter-compatible) , also offers knockback resistance and boosts natural
